baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Plush dinosaur toy. A 22-inch plush dinosaur with a polyester knit body and a faux fur dorsal fin, filled with fibre and a bag of plastic pellets. The Plush dinosaur toy is assembled in Vietnam using components sourced from China and Vietnam.

The sewn and embroidered plush body shell and dorsal fin are produced in China. The polyester fibre fill and pellet bag are produced in Vietnam. 

Final assembly in Vietnam: stuff the shell, sew it closed and finish with seam binding and labels.

key_factors: The sewn and embroidered plush dinosaur body shell
prediction.decisive_step: Cutting, sewing, and embroidering the fabric in China to create the plush dinosaur body shell
prediction.reasoning: The sewn and embroidered plush body shell produced in China imparts the essential character, form, and identity of the plush dinosaur toy. The operations performed in Vietnam—stuffing the pre-sewn shell with fiber fill and pellets, sewing the opening closed, and attaching labels—constitute simple assembly and finishing operations that do not result in a substantial transformation of the Chinese-origin shell (consistent with the principle in N343157 regarding stuffing pre-sewn shells).
